docs.text: On January 31, I'm thinking about a beachy getaway. Port Dover is a charming little town nestled on the shores of Lake Erie. It’s known for its picturesque beach with palm trees, scenic pier, lively main strip, and Friday the 13th motorcycle rallies. #photography #scape #EastCoastKin

Port Dover known for its "Friday the 13th" motorcycle rallies & longest-running Canada Day Parade, founded in 1867. Also a popular fishing town with a seaport & beautiful beaches on Lake Erie. Port Dover is a resort town with charming downtown core, unique shops/boutiques, & live theatre.🇨🇦

Anybody going to the Friday the 13th motorcycle rally in Port Dover? I hope my U.S. Friends that aren't too far from Detroit, Port Huron, Buffalo, (or PA, OH can cross the ferry) make the trek to Port Dover on North Shore of Lake Erie, Ontario. Expecting over 100,000 bikes, all bike types welcome!
